maddeler.e:
أنتدب (form VIII)
# أَنْتَدِبُ (ʔantadibu) /ʔan.ta.di.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْتَدَبَ (intadaba)
# أُنْتَدَبُ (ʔuntadabu) /ʔun.ta.da.bu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَدَبَ (intadaba)
# أَنْتَدِبَ (ʔantadiba) /ʔan.ta.di.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَدَبَ (intadaba)
# أُنْتَدَبَ (ʔuntadaba) /ʔun.ta.da
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
